content:
In the sentence "The doctor phoned the nurse because he was late," the pronoun "he" most likely refers to the doctor. This is because the doctor is the subject of the main clause and the one performing the action (phoning), making it more natural for "he" to refer back to the doctor rather than the nurse.

Thus, it was the doctor who was late.
